agent.name: Tech-news reference agent
agent.job: Periodically collect and summarize new technology stories while preserving bounded cross-cycle memory.
non_goals: Use a workflow solely because it is standard

audit_log_check.failure_condition: A material action has no append-only, attributable audit event.

undeclared_tool_check.failure_condition: The agent invokes a tool not named in its approved tool allowlist.

out_of_scope_data_check.failure_condition: The internal agent reads data outside its declared internal-operational or public scope.

secret_output_check.failure_condition: A credential, token, or secret appears in an agent output or audit event.

workflow.rationale: Cycles are independent; losing one cycle costs one interval and the next cycle catches up.

external_read_check.failure_condition: The expected tenant-scoped durable record cannot be read without a vendor SDK.

freshness_check.failure_condition: A successful cycle is older than the allowed number of cycles without advancing the durable-memory timestamp.

write_behavior_check.failure_condition: updateWorkingMemory was not both offered and called at least once in the configured cycle window.

record_check.failure_condition: A cycle begins work without a precondition_checked event, or a network failure is classified as failed rather than offline.

enforcement_check.failure_condition: The agent continues scheduling work after recorded spend reaches its configured cap.

fixture_refs: not packaged: reference agent external to this repository

check.failure_condition: No fixture result exists for the declared agent output contract.
Any required portable behavior predicate fails.

check.command: review manifest workflow rationale against run design
check.failure_condition: The agent has approval or costly inter-step state but declares workflow.required=false.
A workflow-bearing agent omits the fresh-process recovery check.

conformance.note: This agent has no workflow or mid-flight approval state to resume.

check.failure_condition: No runner evaluates timestamp freshness and offered-and-called memory writes for this agent.

conformance.note: The observed reference run is documented, but its agent implementation and nine-cycle evidence are not in this repository.
